name: LDV RML Mapper
abstract: OpenTelemetry OTLP JSON transformed to PROV-O RDF using an RML transform plugin.
description: The transform uses the RML transformer plugin to convert OTLP resourceSpans into PROV-O RDF. Span and trace records become PROV activities and array-valued data object identifiers become qualified usage references.

transforms.description: Convert an OpenTelemetry OTLP JSON trace into PROV-O RDF using the RML transform plugin.

examples.title: OTLP to PROV-O RML transform input
examples.content: An OTLP trace transformed into PROV-O RDF using the RML plugin.
